about.title: Personal Injury Help in Inglewood, California
about.longDescription: Inglewood moves at its own pace, and its streets stay busy. In 2025, the city's final tally came to 446 injury collisions, with 635 people hurt and 7 lives lost on local roads. Public records show those crashes stacked up most often along Prairie Avenue, Century Boulevard, Manchester Boulevard, and La Brea Avenue, and they tend to peak on Saturdays between 5 p.m. and 7 p.m., when event traffic near SoFi Stadium mixes with weekend errands. If one of those collisions was yours, or you were hurt in a fall, a bike crash, or by a product that failed, you probably have more questions than answers right now. That is where LawProactive comes in. We are a free service that connects injured people with an independent personal injury attorney serving Los Angeles County. We are not a law firm and we do not give legal advice. We simply help you reach someone who does, at no cost to you, and the attorneys in our network work on contingency, which means you pay no fee unless there is a recovery. California gives you two years to file most claims, and less time in some situations, so reaching out sooner keeps your options open.

whyChoose.title: What California Law Means for Your Inglewood Claim

items.title: Two Years to Act, Sometimes Much Less
items.desc: Most California injury claims must be filed within two years of the injury. If a city, county, or other government entity is involved, you may have only six months to file a claim, so timing matters.

items.title: Partial Fault Doesn't End Your Case
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault. Even if you were partly responsible, you can still recover; your share of the blame simply reduces the amount rather than wiping it out.

items.title: No Cap on Pain and Suffering in Ordinary Cases
items.desc: For typical injury claims in California, there is no statutory limit on non-economic damages like pain, suffering, and loss of enjoyment of life. An attorney can help document how the injury changed your daily routine.

items.title: No Fee Unless There Is a Recovery
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency. You don't pay hourly rates or upfront fees, and the attorney's fee comes only from a recovery, if there is one.

items.question: Where do injury crashes in Inglewood tend to happen?
items.answer: Public collision records for 2025 show the highest counts along Prairie Avenue, Century Boulevard, Manchester Boulevard, and La Brea Avenue. Citywide, there were 446 injury collisions that year, with 635 people injured and 7 deaths. Reports also cluster on Saturdays between 5 p.m. and 7 p.m. These are neutral counts from public data, not a judgment about any particular street.

items.question: Is LawProactive a law firm?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and we don't provide legal advice or represent anyone. We connect you with an independent personal injury attorney who serves Los Angeles County, and any attorney-client relationship is between you and that attorney.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim in California?
items.answer: For most personal injury claims, the deadline is two years from the date of injury. If your claim involves a government entity, such as a city bus or a public sidewalk, you may have as little as six months to file a formal claim. Because these deadlines are strict, it's wise to speak with an attorney early.

items.question: What if the crash was partly my fault?
items.answer: California follows pure comparative fault, so being partly to blame does not bar you from recovering. Your percentage of fault reduces your compensation proportionally. An attorney can review the facts and explain how fault might be assigned in your situation.

items.question: What will an attorney cost me?
items.answer: Attorneys in the LawProactive network work on a contingency basis. That means no upfront payment and no hourly billing; the fee is a percentage of any recovery, and if there is no recovery, there is no attorney fee. Our connection service is always free to you.
